name: outliner_edit_roundtrip
description: OL-1: the Outliner duplicates, moves and deletes objects, and keeps its selection by authoring id. A Blank pipeline project gets a Cube and a Floor. Duplicate on Cube sends one duplicate edit; the copy, Cube_copy1, is declared right after Cube and is the one selected (by the created_objects its committed edit names). Dragging its row onto Floor's makes it Floor's child, keeping it where it is; the Inspector's Undo puts it back at the root, still selected. Delete (no children, so no question) removes it and selects the sibling before it, Cube. After Save, the engine is stopped and started again on the saved scene: Cube's authoring id is the same, and the selection is still Cube.
